subject: Telemetry bridge: transient processor notification and onshore-escrow clarification
messages:
From: Sam Mallory <sam.mallory@edgebridge.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: EdgeBridge Legal <legal@edgebridge.io>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notification: transient telemetry relay processor (short-term)

Hi Connor,

Heads up — we need to route a subset of telemetry ingestion through a transient partner while we perform an internal datastore migration. This is a planned, time-limited change (expected window: 30 days starting 2026-05-30) and will only affect metrics/payloads for non-production telemetry (agent health pings, aggregated counters). No customer PII or model inputs/outputs are included.

Summary:
- New temporary subprocessor: StreamLayer Inc. (US)
- Scope: telemetry batching & ephemeral buffering for ingestion (no long-term storage)
- Retention: max 14 days, encrypted at rest with customer key wraps handled by EdgeBridge KMS
- Access: StreamLayer will have strictly scoped service accounts; no human access to payloads without approval

Attached: transient_subproc_roster (spreadsheet) and a simple dataflow diagram.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Do you need a DPA addendum or an expedited SOC2 snapshot to approve this temporary route?
2) Any onshore-escrow or onshore-fallback requirements we should meet pre-go?
3) Who on your security/legal side should we send an evidence bundle to?

We want to get this done quickly and with the right approvals — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sam Mallory
Head of Partnerships | EdgeBridge
attachments: edgebridge_transient_subproc_roster_v1.xlsx, streamlayer_dataflow_diagram.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Mallory <sam.mallory@edgebridge.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notification: transient telemetry relay processor (short-term)

Sam — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. Looping in Laura (legal) and Kimberly (security & compliance) to assess.

Quick asks from our side to speed review:
- Please confirm the precise data fields that StreamLayer will see (sample schema). You said no PII or model IO; we need a field-level statement.
- Confirm encryption w/ KMS: who holds the keys, any cross-account key access, and whether StreamLayer can decrypt payloads?
- Provide the SOC2 snapshot or a concise evidence pack (network diagram, account & role lists, logging retention).
- Clarify the exact cutover time and rollback window; we prefer a short maintenance window with an automatic rollback if telemetry exceeds thresholds.

Laura/Kim — any initial blocker? If you want, Sam can send the DocuSign link for a DPA addendum and we can triage.

Connor O'Brien
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Mallory <sam.mallory@edgebridge.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: EdgeBridge Legal <legal@edgebridge.io>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notification: transient telemetry relay processor (short-term)

Thanks Connor — answers inline below.

Field-level scope:
- StreamLayer will receive: service_id, timestamp, metric_name, metric_value, agent_version, host_region, anonymized_agent_id (hashed, not reversible).
- Confirmed: no model inference payloads, no request/response bodies, no user identifiers beyond anonymized_agent_id.

Encryption/KMS:
- EdgeBridge retains KMS control; payloads are envelope-encrypted before transit. StreamLayer receives encrypted blobs and performs only buffered transfer; they do not hold decryption keys.

Evidence pack (attached):
- StreamLayer SOC2 snapshot (redacted)
- Access control export (roles & service accounts)
- Network/dataflow diagram (streamlayer_dataflow_diagram.pdf)

Cutover plan / rollback:
- Planned cutover: 2026-05-30 02:00 - 04:00 UTC
- Automatic rollback: if error rate or data divergence > 0.5% for 15min, we will revert routing to prior path automatically.

DocuSign for DPA addendum: https://docusign.com/edgebridge/dpa-addendum/ABCD1234 (link valid for 7 days)

Let me know if you need the full unredacted SOC package; can provide under an MSA NDA if required.

Regards,
Sam Mallory
Head of Partnerships | EdgeBridge
attachments: streamlayer_soc2_snapshot_redacted.pdf, access_control_export.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Mallory <sam.mallory@edgebridge.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notification: transient telemetry relay processor (short-term)

Sam — thanks for the prompt details and the attachments. A few items from legal/security before we sign off: 

1) Evidence: we need the SOC2 redacted snapshot plus an attestation from StreamLayer confirming they will not attempt to decrypt any payloads. If you can provide a signed attestation PDF from StreamLayer legal/security, that will speed things up.

2) DPA addendum: we will review the DocuSign. We generally require an addendum for any subprocessor that will touch live telemetry (even if transient). Please include the minimal scope language (metrics-only, no model data, retention 14 days) in the addendum.

3) Onshore fallback / escrow: please confirm a fallback plan that ensures telemetry routing remains onshore (US) and document the escrow process if StreamLayer becomes unavailable. We need a named onshore fallback partner or a statement that EdgeBridge will host a temporary buffer in your US region.

4) SLA / rollback: we expect notification at least 24 hours before cutover for production-adjacent routing and an SLA for evidence delivery within 48 hours of our request. The automatic rollback thresholds you proposed are acceptable; please include them in the addendum.

If you can push the attestation and a SOC2 evidence link to the DocuSign packet, we will aim to have legal + security review and respond within 48 hours. If anything is urgent, pls call my cell — otherwise, we'll handle via the DocuSign+Drive bundle.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Counsel, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | legal@redwoodinference.com
